svg.title: A download is not an offline copy
svg.desc: The same original park sketch appears in ready, downloading, interrupted-update and available-offline components. The pending state gives no percentage or duplicate action; Retry retains an older saved map, while Open saved map follows confirmed storage in this fictional example.

g.text: A download is not an offline copy
Illustrative map states; no actual download
A pending request is not proof of offline storage.
